pick_zh: 至少 3 个 MV、回路耦合、带液位（积分量）的回合里 DMC 成绩居中的一个

cvs.label_zh: CV2（与 MV3 配对），积分型

events.label: Back to the earlier operating point

runs.label: AIO model (current weights)
runs.note: The weights in service, trained on 4 M plant steps; it reads the plant from its own moves, with no test.
runs.note_zh: 现行的这份权重，训练见过 0.0 亿个装置步；不做测试，靠自己的动作读装置。

runs.label: Self-tuning PID (baseline)
runs.note: One PI loop per published pairing, tuned once by the lambda rule on the starting plant's exact step response: what a self-tuner gets from a commissioning step test.
runs.note_zh: 按公布的配对每对一个 PI 回路，用起始装置的精确阶跃响应按 λ 规则整定一次：相当于投运阶跃试验后的自整定。

runs.label: Static-model MPC
runs.note: Constrained MPC given the plant's exact model once at the start for free, corrected from the instruments alone; blind to unmeasured loads, its model never updated after events. The upper reference of the exam tables.
runs.note_zh: 开头白拿一次装置的准确模型、只用仪表读数校正的带约束 MPC；看不到不可测负荷，事件后模型不更新。考试表里的上参照。

runs.label: Oracle MPC (training teacher)
runs.note: Knows the exact model and sees the unmeasured loads; its model catches up 10–40 decisions after a process change; does not know later events. A strong reference, not a bound, and absent at deployment.
runs.note_zh: 知道精确模型、看得见不可测负荷，过程变化后 10–40 个决策才跟上新模型，不知道后面的事件。强参照，不是上限；部署时不存在。

label: Replay episode 32 · 4 events
footnote: Episode 32 of a fixed replay batch (64 episodes, seed 2,000,000, apart from training and validation), of the episodes with a level (an integrating CV), the one with the median static-model MPC score: one new plant with 3 MVs, 3 tracked CVs, 1 zone CV; coupling in series, time scale 43.1 decisions, dead time 0.31 of the time constant, nonlinear; one decision every 10 s. Over 2 h, 4 events. 1 segment at a constrained operating point, where the targets cannot all be held: there the reference is the reachable optimum, and a tracked CV anywhere from its target to the best reachable value, plus a band, is not outside (the wider shading). Values are in % of each channel's range. References on the same episode: the self-tuning PID, the static-model MPC, the oracle MPC (the training teacher) and no action. Outside time counts what the core's score counts, from the first event: tracked CVs outside their band around the reachable reference (the target one dead time back) and zone CVs outside their limits, per CV; the seconds equal each controller's score times the step.
footnote_zh: 固定回放批（64 个回合，种子 2,000,000，与训练、验证都不相交）的第 32 个回合，在带液位（积分量）的回合里取静态模型MPC 成绩居中的那个：一个新装置，3 个 MV、3 个跟踪 CV、1 个区间量；耦合结构串级，时间尺度 43.1 个决策，纯滞后为时间常数的 0.31 倍，非线性；每 10 秒决策一次。2 小时内 4 个事件。其中 1 段是约束工况，目标不能全部保住：这时参考是可达最优点，跟踪 CV 落在目标到可达最优值之间、再外扩一个带宽以内都不算带外（较宽的阴影）。数值是各通道量程的 %。同一回合上的参照：自整定PID、静态模型MPC、oracle MPC（训练用的老师）和不动。带外时间与新核心的评分同一口径，从第一个事件起算：跟踪 CV 偏离可达参考（一个纯滞后之前的目标）超出带宽、区间 CV 越限，按 CV 逐个累计；秒数等于各控制器的评分乘以步长。
